## Outcome and behavior

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the owning issue;
retain parent/checkpoint relationships as explicit links or native identifiers.

## Scope and dependencies

State the bounded change and any prerequisite or remaining owner work.

## Validation

Record actual commands/results, including failures, unavailable checks and
platform limits. Passing local checks is separate from hosted or human acceptance.

## Trust and decision boundaries

Identify relevant privacy, publication, destructive-action or decision gates.
Keep credentials and private data out of the diff and report. Follow local
repository instructions for ADRs, attestations, releases and review.
